name: zfmv_playback_stop_and_close
description: zFMV_Playback::StopAndClose sends MCI_STOP, then MCI_CLOSE on success, and reports the first MCI error.
known_limits: VC5SP3 target zfmv_playback_methods now covers 0x4624f0 and passes with zero unmasked byte mismatches after relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4624f0 validate mciSendCommandA(self->mciDeviceId, 0x808, 2, 0), conditional mciSendCommandA(self->mciDeviceId, 0x804, 2, &closeParams) only when stop succeeds, and ReportMciError on the first nonzero MCI result.
The direct callee 0x462570 zFMV_Playback::ReportMciError is tier S under target zfmv_playback_report_mci_error.

The native stop-and-close smoke patches mciSendCommandA, verifies the exact stop and close command IDs, flags, device ID, null stop params, and non-null close params, then verifies a stop failure skips the close command. The VC5SP3 byte target captures the retail uninitialized close-param stack-slot shape.
